verses.en: But of the times and the seasons, brethren, ye have no need that I write unto you.
verses.pt: Mas, irmãos, acerca dos tempos e das épocas não necessitais de que se vos escreva:
verses.en_web: But concerning the times and the seasons, brothers, you have no need that anything be written to you.
verses.en_bbe: But about the times and their order, my brothers, there is no need for me to say anything to you.

verses.en: For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night.
verses.pt: porque vós mesmos sabeis perfeitamente que o dia do Senhor virá como vem o ladrão de noite;
verses.en_web: For you yourselves know well that the day of the Lord comes like a thief in the night.
verses.en_bbe: For you yourselves have the knowledge that the day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night.

verses.en: For when they shall say, Peace and safety; then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall not escape.
verses.pt: pois quando estiverem dizendo: Paz e segurança! então lhes sobrevirá repentina destruição, como as dores de parto àquela que está grávida; e de modo nenhum escaparão.
verses.en_web: For when they are saying, “Peace and safety,” then sudden destruction will come on them, like birth pains on a pregnant woman; and they will in no way escape.
verses.en_bbe: When they say, There is peace and no danger, then sudden destruction will come on them, as birth-pains on a woman with child; and they will not be able to get away from it.

verses.en: But ye, brethren, are not in darkness, that that day should overtake you as a thief.
verses.pt: Mas vós, irmãos, não estais em trevas, para que aquele dia, como ladrão, vos surpreenda;
verses.en_web: But you, brothers, aren’t in darkness, that the day should overtake you like a thief.
verses.en_bbe: But you, my brothers, are not in the dark, for that day to overtake you like a thief:

verses.en: Ye are all the children of light, and the children of the day: we are not of the night, nor of darkness.
verses.pt: porque todos vós sois filhos da luz e filhos do dia; nós não somos da noite nem das trevas;
verses.en_web: You are all children of light, and children of the day. We don’t belong to the night, nor to darkness,
verses.en_bbe: For you are all sons of light and of the day: we are not of the night or of the dark.

verses.en: Therefore let us not sleep, as do others; but let us watch and be sober.
verses.pt: não durmamos, pois, como os demais, antes vigiemos e sejamos sóbrios.
verses.en_web: so then let’s not sleep, as the rest do, but let’s watch and be sober.
verses.en_bbe: So then, let us not take our rest as the others do, but let us be self-controlled and awake.

verses.en: For they that sleep sleep in the night; and they that be drunken are drunken in the night.
verses.pt: Porque os que dormem, dormem de noite, e os que se embriagam, embriagam-se de noite;
verses.en_web: For those who sleep, sleep in the night; and those who are drunk are drunk in the night.
verses.en_bbe: For those who are sleeping do so in the night; and those who are the worse for drink are so in the night;

verses.en: But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation.
verses.pt: mas nós, porque somos do dia, sejamos sóbrios, vestindo-nos da couraça da fé e do amor, e tendo por capacete a esperança da salvação;
verses.en_web: But let us, since we belong to the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and, for a helmet, the hope of salvation.
verses.en_bbe: But let us, who are of the day, be serious, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and on our heads, the hope of salvation.

verses.en: For God hath not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.pt: porque Deus não nos destinou para a ira, mas para alcançarmos a salvação por nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo,
verses.en_web: For God didn’t appoint us to wrath, but to the obtaining of salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.en_bbe: For God's purpose for us is not wrath, but salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,

verses.en: Who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.
verses.pt: que morreu por nós, para que, quer vigiemos, quer durmamos, vivamos juntamente com ele.
verses.en_web: who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.
verses.en_bbe: Who was put to death for us, so that, awake or sleeping, we may have a part in his life.

verses.en: Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do.
verses.pt: Pelo que exortai-vos uns aos outros e edificai-vos uns aos outros, como na verdade o estais fazendo.
verses.en_web: Therefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as you also do.
verses.en_bbe: So then, go on comforting and building up one another, as you have been doing.

verses.en: And we beseech you, brethren, to know them which labour among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you;
verses.pt: Ora, rogamo-vos, irmãos, que reconheçais os que trabalham entre vós, presidem sobre vós no Senhor e vos admoestam;
verses.en_web: But we beg you, brothers, to know those who labor among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you,
verses.en_bbe: But we make this request to you, my brothers: give attention to those who are working among you, who are over you in the Lord to keep order among you;

verses.en: And to esteem them very highly in love for their work’s sake. And be at peace among yourselves.
verses.pt: e que os tenhais em grande estima e amor, por causa da sua obras. Tende paz entre vós.
verses.en_web: and to respect and honor them in love for their work’s sake. Be at peace among yourselves.
verses.en_bbe: And have a high opinion of them in love because of their work. Be at peace among yourselves.

verses.en: Now we exhort you, brethren, warn them that are unruly, comfort the feebleminded, support the weak, be patient toward all men.
verses.pt: Exortamo-vos também, irmãos, a que admoesteis os insubordinados, consoleis os desanimados, ampareis os fracos e sejais longânimos para com todos.
verses.en_web: We exhort you, brothers, admonish the disorderly, encourage the faint-hearted, support the weak, be patient toward all.
verses.en_bbe: And our desire is that you will keep control over those whose lives are not well ordered, giving comfort to the feeble-hearted, supporting those with little strength, and putting up with much from all.

verses.en: See that none render evil for evil unto any man; but ever follow that which is good, both among yourselves, and to all men.
verses.pt: Vede que ninguém dê a outrem mal por mal, mas segui sempre o bem, uns para com os outros, e para com todos.
verses.en_web: See that no one returns evil for evil to anyone, but always follow after that which is good, for one another, and for all.
verses.en_bbe: Let no one give evil for evil; but ever go after what is good, for one another and for all.

verses.en: Rejoice evermore.
verses.pt: Regozijai-vos sempre.
verses.en_web: Rejoice always.
verses.en_bbe: Have joy at all times.

verses.en: Pray without ceasing.
verses.pt: Orai sem cessar.
verses.en_web: Pray without ceasing.
verses.en_bbe: Keep on with your prayers.

verses.en: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
verses.pt: Em tudo dai graças; porque esta é a vontade de Deus em Cristo Jesus para convosco.
verses.en_web: In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.
verses.en_bbe: In everything give praise: for this is the purpose of God in Christ Jesus for you.

verses.en: Quench not the Spirit.
verses.pt: Não extingais o Espírito;
verses.en_web: Don’t quench the Spirit.
verses.en_bbe: Do not put out the light of the Spirit;

verses.en: Despise not prophesyings.
verses.pt: não desprezeis as profecias,
verses.en_web: Don’t despise prophesies.
verses.en_bbe: Do not make little of the words of the prophets;

verses.en: Prove all things; hold fast that which is good.
verses.pt: mas ponde tudo à prova. Retende o que é bom;
verses.en_web: Test all things, and hold firmly that which is good.
verses.en_bbe: Let all things be tested; keep to what is good;

verses.en: Abstain from all appearance of evil.
verses.pt: Abstende-vos de toda espécie de mal.
verses.en_web: Abstain from every form of evil.
verses.en_bbe: Keep from every form of evil.

verses.en: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.pt: E o próprio Deus de paz vos santifique completamente; e o vosso espírito, e alma e corpo sejam plenamente conservados irrepreensíveis para a vinda de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo.
verses.en_web: May the God of peace himself sanctify you completely. May your whole spirit, soul, and body be preserved blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.en_bbe: And may the God of peace himself make you holy in every way; and may your spirit and soul and body be free from all sin at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.en: Faithful is he that calleth you, who also will do it.
verses.pt: Fiel é o que vos chama, e ele também o fará.
verses.en_web: He who calls you is faithful, who will also do it.
verses.en_bbe: God, by whom you have been marked out in his purpose, is unchanging and will make it complete.

verses.en: Brethren, pray for us.
verses.pt: Irmãos, orai por nós.
verses.en_web: Brothers, pray for us.
verses.en_bbe: Brothers, keep us in mind in your prayers.

verses.en: Greet all the brethren with an holy kiss.
verses.pt: Saudai a todos os irmãos com ósculo santo.
verses.en_web: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.
verses.en_bbe: Give all the brothers a holy kiss.

verses.en: I charge you by the Lord that this epistle be read unto all the holy brethren.
verses.pt: Pelo Senhor vos conjuro que esta epístola seja lida a todos os irmãos.
verses.en_web: I solemnly command you by the Lord that this letter be read to all the holy brothers.
verses.en_bbe: I give orders in the name of the Lord that all the brothers are to be present at the reading of this letter.

verses.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
verses.pt: A graça de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo seja convosco.
verses.en_web: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
verses.en_bbe: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
